mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward rank information criteria (IC) < 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL inflation spike above 2.0% triggers investor fears of tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in GDPC1 (economic demand) indicates dual accommodative policy and robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls > 1% and GDPC1 rises > 2% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positively correlated with proxy changes (information criteria IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion (INDPRO > 110), a decline in FEDFUNDS amplifies equity gains by reducing policy tightness, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS falls below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden monthly UNRATE increase above 6% signals labor market stress, prompting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate recession.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 6%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising INDPRO (supply) and HOUST (demand) simultaneously indicate robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 2.5% and HOUST rises > 5% in a month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not positively correlated with proxy changes (information criteria IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in FEDFUNDS coupled with a surge in RSAFS (economic demand) signals dual accommodative policy and strong demand, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls > 1.5% and RSAFS rises > 3% in a month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when proxies move as predicted.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in PAYEMS (employment) and fall in UNRATE (unemployment) signals labor market tightening, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 50,000 and UNRATE falls > 0.2% in a month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when proxies move as expected.
